people.name: Eglon
people.line: Amorite king of Lachish; city in Judah

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Jarmuth
people.line: A Canaanite city, later allotted to Judah

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: They did so, and brought those five kings out of the cave to him: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
translations.bsb: So they brought the five kings out of the cave—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.
translations.kjv: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
translations.asv: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon.
